fields.one_liner: B2B restocking app with short-term credit for small-town kirana stores.
fields.founder_1: Aarav Deshmukh, CEO LinkedIn: linkedin.com/in/aarav-deshmukh-example Background: FMCG distribution and field operations, 8 years. Ran a regional sales team at a large distributor.
fields.founder_2: Pooja Nair, CTO LinkedIn: linkedin.com/in/pooja-nair-example Background: Software engineer at a payments company, 5 years. Built the ordering app and our credit-scoring rules.
fields.equity: Founders 85%, angels 15%. ESOP pool to be created.

fields.customers: 42 retailers onboarded, 22 of whom have ordered more than once.
fields.revenue: GMV of about INR 9 lakh in the last three months. Revenue is trade margin of about 4% plus a credit fee on credit orders.

fields.other_investors: One pre-seed fund. No term sheet yet.
fields.heard_from: Introduction through a founder in your Fund I portfolio.
fields.anything_else: We have been told our credit-scoring approach is an edge. Happy to walk you through it on a call. We would also welcome your help with introductions to NBFCs.

fields.founder_1: Karthik Subramanian, CEO. IIT Madras, mechanical engineering. 5 years as a reliability engineer at an engine maker. linkedin.com/in/karthik-subramanian-example
fields.founder_2: Neeraj Pillai, CTO. 4 years in embedded systems at an auto-components supplier. Designed the sensor board and firmware. linkedin.com/in/neeraj-pillai-example
fields.built: A clip-on sensor measuring vibration and temperature, a gateway, and a model that learns each motor's normal pattern in 14 days. Alerts go to WhatsApp.
fields.customers: 11 pilots started since March 2026. 6 converted to paid, across 140 sensors (average 23 per customer).
fields.revenue: INR 14.2 L cumulative, of which hardware INR 13.3 L. Monthly recurring subscription INR 1.05 L.

fields.existing_investors: INR 30 L: a INR 10 L incubator grant and two angels (INR 20 L).
fields.use_of_funds: Team, sensor inventory and pilots, certification and operations.
fields.heard_from: Public application form. Our incubator mentor also suggested we apply.
fields.anything_else: We would value a conversation about manufacturing scale-up and calibration. Happy to share pilot data.
